newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan tenders to sell term Jan-Jun '97 fuel oil.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan tenders to sell term Jan-Jun '97 fuel oil.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has issued a term tender to sell 3.0-percent sulphur fuel oil for January-June 1997 deliveries, a CPC source said on Wednesday.
CPC seeks to sell four to six cargoes of 30,000 tonnes each on a free-on-board (fob) basis.
The tender closes on December 9 and bids are valid for three days.
CPC started selling high sulphur, 180 centistoke-grade fuel oil on a six-monthly term basis since early this year. It has sold about 10 cargoes during the whole of the year in two tenders.
CPC also exports one or two cargoes of 30,000 tonnes each by monthly spot tenders.
In its latest spot tender, CPC sold two cargoes for December 15-27 lifting around $121 per tonne, fob Kaohsiung.
